policy.privacy_text: When you use Neutra+, you entrust your data and information, and we commit to keeping this data protected through a protection system. In this sense, this privacy policy document clearly and accessibly explains how your information and data will be collected, used, shared, and stored by our systems. By using our services, you understand that we will collect and use your personal information in the ways described in this Policy, under the norms of the Federal Constitution of 1988 (art. 5º, LXXIX; and art. 22º, XXX – included by EC 115/2022), the Data Protection regulations (LGPD, Federal Law 13.709/2018), consumer provisions of Federal Law 8078/1990, and other applicable Brazilian legal standards.
policy.attention_text: Please be sure to read our Privacy Policy, because by using the platform and our services, you are subject to its applications. If in doubt, please contact us.

policy.personalized_experience: Provide a personalized experience for you.
policy.connect_with_people: Connect you with the people and organizations you care about.
policy.promote_safety: Promote the safety, protection, and integrity of our services, combat harmful conduct, and protect our user community.
policy.use_advanced_tech: Use and develop advanced technologies to provide secure and functional services for everyone.
policy.research_improvements: Research ways to improve our services.
policy.consistent_integrated_experience: Provide consistent and integrated experiences across Neutra+ services.

policy.legal_text: The services offered by Neutra+, a platform owned by BMO INOVA SIMPLES (I.S.), are intended exclusively for the telecommunications and ISP market. Neutra+ acts as an intermediary that facilitates network leasing, serving as a neutral agent between the parties. All contracts and terms agreed upon between providers and operators are the responsibility of the involved parties and Neutra+ as a neutral agent, with privacy policies available on our website and the links above.

errors.forbidden: Your account cannot access the KYC queue. It requires approval permission and MFA confirmed in this session.
errors.failed: We could not load the organizations.

review.decisionHint: Decide every document first. The decision is applied to the organization's account.

notices.submitted: The review has not started. Starting it assigns it to you.
notices.assignedToOther: This review is assigned to another reviewer. You can view it but not decide.
notices.unconfirmedDecision: The last decision sent from here was not confirmed. Resend it to find out whether it was recorded — the same decision is never duplicated.
notices.specialReview: The 3-correction limit was reached: the request went to special review and accepts no new decisions here.
notices.applied: Decision "{{decision}}" recorded and applied to the account.
notices.applying: Decision recorded. Applying it to the account is still in progress.
notices.stale: The organization changed after the decision, so it could not be applied. Refresh the review to decide again with the current data.
notices.applyFailed: Decision recorded but not applied to the account: {{error}}.
notices.applyFailedUnknown: Decision recorded but not applied to the account.
notices.retryElsewhere: The retry must be made by whoever decided, in the browser the decision was sent from.
notices.sanctionsPending: The sanctions check is not cleared. Approving the {{level}} level requires it to pass. Run the check again to update the result.
notices.sanctionsMatch: The sanctions check found a possible match. Approval stays blocked until compliance handles the case.
notices.sanctionsNotSynced: The sanctions check passed in Identity at {{date}}, but the review has not received the result yet. Try again in a moment.

sanctionsMatches.title: Sanctions list matches
sanctionsMatches.subtitle: The check compares the organization's legal name and tax document against the OFAC, UN and BACEN lists. Partners and KYC files are not compared.
sanctionsMatches.empty: No match recorded. The failure may come from a list that did not respond or is outdated. Run the check again.

reasons.name: Legal name "{{name}}" is similar to a name on the list ({{score}}% similarity)

errors.forbidden: Your user is not allowed to view sanctions matches (sanctions:read_matches).
errors.loadFailed: We could not load the sanctions matches.
